description: Source code for an LWM2M IPSO Filling Sensor implementation in Zephyr RTOS, managing sensor resource states, creation, and updates.

methods.name: reset_average_fill_speed_cb
methods.description: Callback to reset the average fill speed for a sensor instance.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update the full/empty status based on fill percentage and thresholds, notify observers if status changes.

methods.name: update_cb
methods.description: Callback for resource updates, triggers status update.

methods.name: filling_sensor_create
methods.description: Creates a new filling sensor instance with default values and resource initialization.

methods.name: fill_sensor_init
methods.description: Initializes and registers the filling sensor object.
